`end if` followed by the next statement is still valid Ruby. At worst the next ERB output statement becomes the modifier's condition, which is truthy, so the template should render normally; the comment itself hedges with "may" and names no concrete failure.

On successful deletes, the metric's kind label is set to the object name instead of options.Kind. This records wrong data and creates one Prometheus label series per deleted object name, which is unbounded cardinality and grows memory.
